REGISTRY_unregistered_subagents.CORRECTED_ROOT_CAUSE: NOT a session-registry sync gap. The 4 files were physically malformed: a `<!-- size-justification: ... -->` HTML comment sat on LINE 1, pushing the YAML frontmatter opener `---` to line 2. CC's agent loader requires `---` on the first byte; with a comment first it parses no frontmatter, so the agents get no name/tools and are never registered. A restart alone would NOT have fixed this.
